create_blaser_config: create a BlaserConfig with input_form set to QE or COMET and a specified embedding_dim
create_blaser_model: create a BlaserModel from a BlaserConfig using _create_blaser_model factory function
test_blaser_qe_forward: test the BLASER-QE forward method produces shape (batch_size, 1) and ignores the ref argument
test_blaser_ref_forward: test the BLASER-COMET forward method requires a ref argument and raises ValueError without it
test_blaser_featurize_input: test the featurize_input method concatenates src, mt, ref embeddings with pointwise products and differences
